name: Provider Data Mis-match — G17 and G24 events with no handle-direct note: work the exception sweep and reject with PX_RG2400
description: Sixteen guided steps, one per row of the requester's G24.2 step table: identify the PX_G17 and PX_G24 events, find the WGS notes carry no comment directing the claim be handled directly, note the National state, confirm the claim image matches and the service location is not an Our Insurance state, then work ten exception gates — Medicare primary, Medicaid Reclamation, VA or Military Hospital, member-submitted, ancillary services and Air Ambulance, encounter claim, Home Infusion Therapy, contiguous county, benefit coverage and duplicate history — before rejecting the claim with reject code PX_RG2400.

steps.name: Identify the PX_G17 and PX_G24 events
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab and review all events set on this claim, informational ones included, before paying, denying or routing it. Look for PX_G17 and PX_G24. PX_G24 fires when the provider is in a state outside the 17 states Elevance handles, and PX_G17 and PX_G24 are the pair seen most often. If you need assistance on the order events are worked in, refer to the Hierarchy of Events document. Here PX_G24 is the only Hard Edit — PX_G17, PX_SPS and PX_CIS are all Informational — so no other priority event stands ahead of it and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes as soon as the trainee opens the Event Resolution tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab and read the All Edits list. PX_G24 is the active Hard Edit; PX_G17 sits directly beneath it.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the PX_G17 and PX_G24 events

steps.name: Review the WGS notes for handle-direct comments
steps.description: Open the Notes tab, then the Claim Notes sub-tab, and read the WGS Notes sub-section under Mainframe Claim Notes to determine whether there are comments indicating the claim should be handled directly. If the comments indicate handle-direct, process the claim according to operational guidelines. Here the WGS Notes carry no such comment, so the claim is not to be handled direct and you continue to the reviews below.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Notes sub-tab. Opening the Notes tab alone is not enough -- the sub-tab starts closed and its sections are not rendered until it is selected. The WGS section is EMPTY here; the step grades going and looking, because there is no value to match.
steps.hint: Click the 'Notes' tab, then the 'Claim Notes' sub-tab, and scroll to WGS Notes under Mainframe Claim Notes.
steps.checklistItem: Review the WGS notes for handle-direct comments

steps.name: Note the National state
steps.description: Open the Provider Information tab and note the value of the National state field in the Billing section. Here the National state is DC, which is outside the states Elevance handles. Carry that value to the next step — you are about to check that it was keyed correctly.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Provider Information tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Provider Info' tab and read the National state field in the Billing section.

steps.name: Verify provider coding and review the service location
steps.description: Open the Claim Image tab and determine whether the provider coding and the National state were correctly entered in the application — the National state on the claim image must match the Provider Information tab. Here the claim image also shows National state DC, so the fields were entered correctly. Then scroll down to the Rendering section for the service location review: determine whether the physical address where the services are rendered is an Our Insurance state, found in Box 32 (Service Facility Location Information). Here the address is 3511 LAKE ELMO AVE N STE, LAKE ELMO, DC — not an Our Insurance state — so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Image tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Image' tab. Compare the National state in the Billing section with the Provider Information tab, then read Box 32 in the Rendering section.
steps.checklistItem: Verify provider coding and review the service location

steps.name: Check whether Medicare is primary
steps.description: Determine whether Medicare is primary by opening the Search tab and then the Limited Liability sub-tab. Here the record shows Type COB, Effective date 01/01/2024, no End date, and Order of benefits 'P – Our Insurance is primary'. Medicare is not primary, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Limited Liability sub-tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Search' tab, then the 'Limited Liability' sub-tab, and read the Order of benefits column.

steps.name: Check for the HPD event (Medicaid Reclamation)
steps.description: Determine whether the claim is a Medicaid Reclamation claim by returning to the Event Resolution tab and checking whether an HPD event is set. If the claim is a Medicaid Reclamation claim, follow those guidelines. Here no HPD event is found — the only events on this claim are PX_G24, PX_G17, PX_SPS and PX_CIS — so the claim is not a Medicaid Reclamation claim and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Returns to a tab step 1 opened. The suffix is documentary: the engine grades only the ACTIVE step and never scans visit history, so a fresh click is required either way.
steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab again and scan the All Edits list for an HPD event.
steps.checklistItem: Check for the HPD event (Medicaid Reclamation)

steps.name: Check for a VA or Military Hospital provider
steps.description: Determine whether the provider is a Veterans Administration (VA) or Military Hospital by returning to the Provider Information tab and reading the Name field in the Billing section. Here the provider name is UNITED HEALTH CLINIC, so the provider is not a VA or Military Hospital and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Returns to a tab step 3 opened. The suffix is documentary: the engine grades only the ACTIVE step and never scans visit history, so a fresh click is required either way.
steps.hint: Click the 'Provider Info' tab again and read the Name field in the Billing section.
steps.checklistItem: Check for a VA or Military Hospital provider

steps.name: Confirm the claim is not member-submitted
steps.description: Determine whether the claim is a member-submitted claim by opening the Claim Data tab, then the Details sub-tab, and reading the Claim type field in the Additional Claim Data section. Here the Claim type is PA - Professional, so the claim is not member-submitted and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Details sub-tab under Claim Data.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Data' tab, then the 'Details' sub-tab, and read the Claim type field.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm the claim is not member-submitted

steps.name: Review the service type and Air Ambulance
steps.description: Review the services billed on the claim and determine whether they are ancillary — Durable Medical Equipment (DME), Independent Laboratory (DXL), Home Infusion Therapy Supplies (HIT) or Specialty Pharmacy (SPC) — by reading the Service and Procedure code fields on the Claim Lines tab. Here the Service is PHT and the procedure code is 97110, which is physical therapy, so the services are not ancillary. Also determine whether the services billed are Air Ambulance services; they are not, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claim Lines tab.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Lines' tab and read the Service and Procedure fields on line 1.
steps.checklistItem: Review the service type and Air Ambulance

steps.name: Check for the EP1 event (Encounter claim)
steps.description: Determine whether the claim is being processed as an encounter by returning to the Event Resolution tab and checking whether an EP1 event is set. If the claim is processing as an encounter, follow those guidelines. Here no EP1 event is found, so the claim is not processing as an encounter and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Returns to a tab steps 1 and 6 opened. The suffix is documentary: the engine grades only the ACTIVE step and never scans visit history, so a fresh click is required either way.
steps.hint: Click the 'Event Resolution' tab again and scan the All Edits list for an EP1 event.
steps.checklistItem: Check for the EP1 event (Encounter claim)

steps.name: Confirm the services are not Home Infusion Therapy
steps.description: Determine whether the services billed are for Home Infusion Therapy by returning to the Claim Lines tab and reviewing the Service and Procedure code fields. Here the Service is PHT and the procedure code is 97110, which is physical therapy, so the services are not Home Infusion Therapy and you continue to the contiguous county review.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Returns to a tab step 9 opened. The suffix is documentary: the engine grades only the ACTIVE step and never scans visit history, so a fresh click is required either way.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claim Lines' tab again and re-read the Service and Procedure fields.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm the services are not Home Infusion Therapy

steps.name: Contiguous County Review
steps.description: Determine whether the provider is located in a contiguous county by returning to the Provider Information tab and reading the Pricing ZIP field in the Rendering section. Here the Pricing ZIP is 12345-9998. Check the first five digits of the ZIP, 12345, against the Contiguous Counties - All States document: a provider in a contiguous county has its ZIP listed there. If the provider is not located in a contiguous county, proceed to the next step. Here the provider is not located in a contiguous county, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Returns to a tab steps 3 and 7 opened. The suffix is documentary: the engine grades only the ACTIVE step and never scans visit history, so a fresh click is required either way.
steps.hint: Click the 'Provider Info' tab again and read the Pricing ZIP field in the Rendering section, then look up its first five digits in the Contiguous Counties - All States document.

steps.name: Verify benefit coverage
steps.description: Determine whether the services and/or diagnosis are covered under the member's benefits by opening the Search tab and then the Benefits sub-tab. Here the plan covers physical therapy in the office setting, so the services are covered under the member's benefits and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Benefits sub-tab under Search.
steps.hint: Click the 'Search' tab, then the 'Benefits' sub-tab, and read the plan options for a physical therapy benefit.

steps.name: Review history for a duplicate claim
steps.description: Review the member's claim history to determine whether the claim is a duplicate by opening the Search tab and then the Claims sub-tab. If the claim is a duplicate, follow those guidelines. Here no claim is found in history, so the claim is not a duplicate. Every exception has now been ruled out, so the claim is rejected to the plan that can key it.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the trainee opens the Claims sub-tab under Search. Step 13 leaves the trainee on the Search tab, so this is a sub-tab change within the open tab -- recordSubTabVisit fires on the change.
steps.hint: Click the 'Claims' sub-tab under Search and read the search results.
steps.checklistItem: Review history for a duplicate claim

steps.name: Deny the claim using Reject code PX_RG2400
steps.description: The claim is not a duplicate and none of the preceding exceptions apply, so reject it with reject code PX_RG2400, which instructs the provider to submit the claim to their local Blue Cross Blue Shield plan. Open the Action menu, select Deny, select reject code PX_RG2400 and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the deny panel is submitted with the reject code. PX_RG2400 is the only code offered.
steps.hint: Open the Action menu in the header, choose 'Deny claim', select PX_RG2400 and submit the panel.
steps.completionToast: Claim denied with reject code PX_RG2400.
steps.checklistItem: Deny the claim using Reject code PX_RG2400

steps.name: Submit Deny decision
steps.description: Go to the Decision section in the header, select 'Deny' from the dropdown and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the claim is submitted. Deny is the correct decision; Pay scores zero for the decision component.
steps.hint: Open the Decision dropdown in the header, choose 'Deny', then click Submit.
